question: How many elements are there in the Walls category?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Element AS e JOIN Category AS c ON e.Category = c._key WHERE c.Name = 'Walls'

question: How many elements are there in the Doors category?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Element AS e JOIN Category AS c ON e.Category = c._key WHERE c.Name = 'Doors'

question: How many elements are there in room 200?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Element AS e JOIN Room AS r ON e.Room = r._key WHERE r.Number = '200'

question: What is the area of room number 301 in square feet, rounded to one decimal?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(Area, 1) FROM Room WHERE Number = '301'

question: What is the volume of room number 108 in cubic feet, rounded to one decimal?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(Volume, 1) FROM Room WHERE Number = '108'

question: How many rooms are in the model?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Room

question: How many sheets are in the drawing set?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ViewSheet

question: Who is the client for this project?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT ClientName FROM BimDocument WHERE ClientName <> ''

question: What is the project's street address?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Address FROM BimDocument WHERE Address <> ''

question: Which discipline models are still at the Design Development stage?
gold_sql: SELECT Title FROM BimDocument WHERE Status = 'Design Development'

question: How many warnings are there in the model?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Warning

question: What is the most frequent warning in the model?
gold_sql: SELECT Description FROM Warning GROUP BY Description ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many distinct elements are affected by warnings?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Element) FROM ElementInWarning

question: What is the name of the largest room by area?
gold_sql: SELECT e.Name FROM Room AS r JOIN Element AS e ON r.Element = e._key ORDER BY r.Area DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which room contains the most elements?
gold_sql: SELECT r.Number FROM Element AS e JOIN Room AS r ON e.Room = r._key GROUP BY r.Number ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many furniture elements are there in room 200?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Element AS e JOIN Category AS c ON e.Category = c._key JOIN Room AS r ON e.Room = r._key WHERE c.Name = 'Furniture' AND r.Number = '200'

question: What is the elevation of level L3 in the architectural model, in feet, rounded to two decimals?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(l.Elevation, 2) FROM Level AS l JOIN Element AS le ON l.Element = le._key JOIN BimDocument AS d ON le.BimDocument = d._key WHERE le.Name = 'L3' AND d.Title = 'SNOWDON_ARCH.r2027'

question: How many instances of the 'Round Elbow' family are placed in the model?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FamilyInstance AS fi JOIN FamilyType AS ft ON fi.FamilyType = ft._key JOIN Family AS f ON ft.Family = f._key JOIN Element AS fe ON f.Element = fe._key WHERE fe.Name = 'Round Elbow'

question: How many placed elements use the 'Copper' family type?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FamilyInstance AS fi JOIN FamilyType AS ft ON fi.FamilyType = ft._key JOIN Element AS te ON ft.Element = te._key WHERE te.Name = 'Copper'

question: How many rooms are on level L3?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Room AS r JOIN Element AS e ON r.Element = e._key JOIN Level AS l ON e.Level = l._key JOIN Element AS le ON l.Element = le._key WHERE le.Name = 'L3'

question: What is the total area of all office unit rooms, in square feet rounded to one decimal?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(r.Area), 1) FROM Room AS r JOIN Element AS e ON r.Element = e._key WHERE e.Name LIKE 'Office Unit%'

question: How many elements belong to the 'Domestic Cold Water 1' system?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ElementInSystem AS eis JOIN System AS s ON eis.System = s._key JOIN Element AS se ON s.Element = se._key WHERE se.Name = 'Domestic Cold Water 1'

question: Which MEP system contains the most elements?
gold_sql: SELECT se.Name FROM ElementInSystem AS eis JOIN System AS s ON eis.System = s._key JOIN Element AS se ON s.Element = se._key GROUP BY se.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the total volume of 'Concrete, Cast-in-Place gray' in the model, in cubic feet rounded to one decimal?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(mie.Volume), 1) FROM MaterialInElement AS mie JOIN Material AS m ON mie.Material = m._key WHERE m.Name = 'Concrete, Cast-in-Place gray'

question: How many elements does the plumbing discipline model contain?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Element AS e JOIN BimDocument AS d ON e.BimDocument = d._key WHERE d.Title = 'Snowdon Towers Sample Plumbing'

question: How many levels are defined in the architectural model?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Level AS l JOIN Element AS le ON l.Element = le._key JOIN BimDocument AS d ON le.BimDocument = d._key WHERE d.Title = 'SNOWDON_ARCH.r2027'

question: Which level in the architectural model has the highest elevation?
gold_sql: SELECT le.Name FROM Level AS l JOIN Element AS le ON l.Element = le._key JOIN BimDocument AS d ON le.BimDocument = d._key WHERE d.Title = 'SNOWDON_ARCH.r2027' ORDER BY l.Elevation DESC LIMIT 1

question: What is the occupancy type of room 301?
gold_sql: SELECT p.Value FROM Room AS r JOIN Parameter AS p ON p.Element = r.Element JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key WHERE r.Number = '301' AND pd.Name = 'Occupancy'

question: How many rooms have a 'Residential One Story' occupancy?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Room AS r JOIN Parameter AS p ON p.Element = r.Element JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key WHERE pd.Name = 'Occupancy' AND p.Value = 'Residential One Story'

question: How many doors are placed on level L4?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FamilyInstance AS fi JOIN Element AS e ON fi.Element = e._key JOIN Category AS c ON e.Category = c._key JOIN Level AS l ON e.Level = l._key JOIN Element AS le ON l.Element = le._key WHERE c.Name = 'Doors' AND le.Name = 'L4'

question: Which level has the most doors placed on it?
gold_sql: SELECT le.Name FROM FamilyInstance AS fi JOIN Element AS e ON fi.Element = e._key JOIN Category AS c ON e.Category = c._key JOIN Level AS l ON e.Level = l._key JOIN Element AS le ON l.Element = le._key WHERE c.Name = 'Doors' GROUP BY le.Name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which door types have a fire rating of 90 minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT te.Name FROM FamilyType AS ft JOIN Element AS te ON ft.Element = te._key JOIN Category AS c ON te.Category = c._key JOIN Parameter AS p ON p.Element = te._key JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key WHERE c.Name = 'Doors' AND pd.Name = 'Fire Rating' AND p.Value = '90 MIN'

question: How many wall types have a 2-hour fire rating?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT te.Name) FROM FamilyType AS ft JOIN Element AS te ON ft.Element = te._key JOIN Category AS c ON te.Category = c._key JOIN Parameter AS p ON p.Element = te._key JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key WHERE c.Name = 'Walls' AND pd.Name = 'Fire Rating' AND p.Value = '2 HR'

question: How many doors are installed whose door type has a 90-minute fire rating?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FamilyInstance AS fi JOIN FamilyType AS ft ON fi.FamilyType = ft._key JOIN Element AS te ON ft.Element = te._key JOIN Category AS c ON te.Category = c._key JOIN Parameter AS p ON p.Element = te._key JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key WHERE c.Name = 'Doors' AND pd.Name = 'Fire Rating' AND p.Value = '90 MIN'

question: What is the total length of all pipes in the model, in feet rounded to one decimal?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CAST(p.Value AS REAL)), 1) FROM Parameter AS p JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key JOIN Element AS e ON p.Element = e._key JOIN Category AS c ON e.Category = c._key WHERE pd.Name = 'Length' AND c.Name = 'Pipes'

question: What is the name of sheet A101?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT pname.Value FROM ViewSheet AS vs JOIN Parameter AS pnum ON pnum.Element = vs.Element JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS dnum ON pnum.ParameterDescriptor = dnum._key JOIN Parameter AS pname ON pname.Element = vs.Element JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS dname ON pname.ParameterDescriptor = dname._key WHERE dnum.Name = 'Sheet Number' AND pnum.Value = 'A101' AND dname.Name = 'Sheet Name'

question: Which structural material is assigned to the most structural elements (ignoring blank and '<By Category>' values)?
gold_sql: SELECT p.DisplayValue FROM Parameter AS p JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key WHERE pd.Name = 'Structural Material' AND p.DisplayValue NOT IN ('', '<By Category>') GROUP BY p.DisplayValue ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

question: On which level is room 301 located?
gold_sql: SELECT le.Name FROM Room AS r JOIN Element AS e ON r.Element = e._key JOIN Level AS l ON e.Level = l._key JOIN Element AS le ON l.Element = le._key WHERE r.Number = '301'

question: How many family types in the model have any fire rating value recorded?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ft._key) FROM FamilyType AS ft JOIN Parameter AS p ON p.Element = ft.Element JOIN ParameterDescriptor AS pd ON p.ParameterDescriptor = pd._key WHERE pd.Name = 'Fire Rating' AND p.Value <> ''
